Example plot:
```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
data <- readRDS("Data/aitkin_parcels_sf.rds")

labels <- lapply(data$OWNER_NAME, HTML)

leaflet(data) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(
    label = labels
  )
```
